s1.desc: a kitchen drawn on a plain pale grey background, with a long low counter of peach cabinets under a pale aqua countertop

s2.desc: a bathroom corner drawn on a plain pale grey background, with a teal shower curtain hanging from a rail under a shower head

spans.notes: Couch: Pax sits holding a phone (grey back, small tuft, probably the iFin), hops up and drops down beside Polly. Slow push-in over the whole shot: bbox of couch+shadow 469->489 px wide (540 px frame) f0->f39.

spans.view: with a round window and a white wall cabinet above the counter

beats.text: Pax waddles left toward the kitchen counter while Polly follows right behind him
Pax opens a low cabinet door and leans in to look at the snacks inside while Polly waits behind him
Pax pulls out a bag of chips and turns around, hugging it to his chest with a smile
Polly wraps her flippers around Pax from behind with her eyes closed and rosy cheeks while he holds the chips

spans.notes: Polly is cut by the right edge for the first ~5 frames as they walk left. Background edges (window, wall cabinet, counter) overlap exactly in compare 40/60, 60/110, 40/110.

Outside the igloo: Pax holds a pile of black trash bags, Polly helps with one flipper. Continuous pull-back from a close shot of Pax (fast between f127 and f131), then the igloo keeps drifting left to f149 (compare 133/149: doubled igloo and tree edges).
Pax showering, eyes closed, soap foam on his head; 18 frames.

spans.view: with a pale yellow bath mat on the floor and a bag of chips on the floor

beats.text: Polly sits beside the shower curtain munching a chip and holding {ifin} while a dark penguin shadow stands still behind the curtain
Pax pushes the curtain aside and peeks out with soap foam on his head as Polly holds the phone screen up to show him

spans.notes: Pax is only a dark silhouette behind the curtain until f196, so he is listed as entering at f196 and the silhouette is not named. Phone: pale grey back, camera lenses, little tuft on top = iFin. Shower rail, head and mat edges overlap exactly in compare 168/207. | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_2): The phone Polly holds for the whole span has a small blue Pax-style penguin figure clinging to its top edge (not the iFin's grey tuft), visible in every frame (full res f170, f180, f190, f200): a lead copy under the 2026-10-26 rule, as in Vibing 118-179. Camera locked (shower rail and mat edges black 168/207).
